tvShow.name: The Last Frontier
tvShow.overview: When a prison transport plane crashes in the remote Alaskan wilderness—freeing dozens of violent inmates—the region's lone marshal must protect the town he's vowed to keep safe.

episodes.name: Blue Skies
episodes.overview: An unprecedented emergency sends Fairbanks into lockdown. Frank gathers every resource available to mount a full-scale response.

episodes.name: Wind of Change
episodes.overview: Luke tries to get back home as the manhunt for Havlock intensifies. Frank weighs whether he should give in to a set of demands.

episodes.name: Country as F**k
episodes.overview: Sarah's disappearance adds urgency to Frank's search. Havlock's master plan takes an unexpected turn, increasing the number of hostages.

episodes.name: American Dream
episodes.overview: A state trooper goes missing, widening Frank's investigation. Armed locals join the manhunt. Sarah grows concerned over Luke's whereabouts.

episodes.name: Arnaq
episodes.overview: Frank focuses on tracking down Luke. The CIA's involvement ramps up as Havlock's plan enters a new phase.

episodes.name: The Devil Wears a Suit and Tie
episodes.overview: Fairbanks is hit with a mass power outage. Sarah spots someone suspicious in the ER. Sidney tries to get control of a key piece of evidence.

episodes.name: Change of Time
episodes.overview: A mysterious new suspect is interrogated. Frank's secret comes to light. Havlock works on retrieving the contents of his hard drive.

episodes.name: L'air Perdu
episodes.overview: Sidney learns about her father's past, the Atwater Protocol, and the classified intel in Archive 6.

episodes.name: Converge
episodes.overview: Bradford lands in Fairbanks with a CIA task force and new primary target. Sidney makes a desperate attempt to expose the truth.

episodes.name: Everything Trying
episodes.overview: Sidney and Havlock risk it all to gain possession of the archive. Frank sets out on a life-saving mission.

reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
"The Last Frontier", is, in broad terms, a contemporized Western.

There's a posse, led by a hard nosed Marshal, out to get escaped outlaws, in the unforgiving wilderness of Alaska. What makes this a little better than it might sound, on first inspection, is an espionage, conspiracy, tie in. 

Yes, I know the latter trope has been done to death, with some truly awful spy based series but this time around, its a good mix. The notion of a coldly calculating female CIA operative out to catch a nefarious figure, who has gone rogue, whilst working with and against the Marshall, whose overriding desire is to protect his family and community, offers an interesting contrast.

Blended into this mix is creative, polished but also, at times, over the top action and more than capable performances, from the cast. 

In summary, a contemporary Western espionage, action thriller done the right way. Well worth a look.
